features.integration_review: Thermal owns body and peripheral exposure; Core supplies world conditions, fatigue and material data, optional sibling snapshots retain their owners. No independent shared resource budget. Core #267 adminRestore is public revision 4; no foreign cure. Trauma #239 uses public physiology perfusion as authoritative heat-distribution input, replacing blood proxy when available. Frostbite exposure uses bounded local game-time timing; successful Trauma report resets full local budget, no duplicate injury or changes to Trauma records.

RC54 Core API 15 PhysicalMaterials thermalResistance is authoritative for series wall resistance. Thermal owns cladding placement, geometric thickness and room air evolution; API exposes the actual face query used by the solver. Straw uses vanilla hay fire hooks, clay is nonflammable; native block lifecycle invalidates actual room state, so no separate fire capability or duplicate material table is needed. Enclosed air receives bounded waste heat from living noncreative nonspectator occupants, using Thermal's room solver and Core material profiles for snow/ice; no new resource deduction or global weather change. Leaf canopy consumes optional Terrarian resource tags; compact snow insulation and bare-handed packing operate on actual vanilla snow. No duplicate provider state. Core 1.5.1 protection-only break check gates direct gathering and accepted work charges Core once; no foreign state. Guide describes the authoritative room geometry and tool-free snow recovery; Core climate inconsistency tracked at #276 without consumer override.
Existing devices, wearable layers and portable heat sources feed Thermal exposure and room simulation; physical data are read from Core where supported.
